_help: On-demand areas shown by the 'On demand' button. Each area points at Translink's page that links to its map files (KML). The weekly refresh re-reads these pages. 'how' is the short explanation shown on the card. See README.md, section 'On-demand areas'. Traced areas: 'picture' says which Translink page shows the area's map picture; tools/trace_ondemand.py re-traces it when the picture changes. 'not_drawn' lists on-demand pages that are deliberately left off the map (outside SEQ, or no map), so they don't raise an issue.

areas.name: Gold Coast on demand

zone_names.SmallPacificPinesZone_AH: Roam zone A: Pacific Pines and parts of Oxenford, Maudsland and Gaven
zone_names.NerangZone_AH: Roam zone B: Nerang, Highland Park and parts of Worongary

areas.how: Pre-booked shared service. It picks you up close to home inside the roam zone and takes you to a key location, and back again.

areas.name: Logan on demand (DRT)
areas.how: Pre-booked shared service. It picks you up near home in these suburbs and drops you at one of the destinations below. For the trip home, you're picked up at the destination. Book at least two hours ahead.

areas.name: Ipswich Flexilink
areas.how: Shared service that runs hourly. It picks you up from home and drops you anywhere in the roam zone or at a key location. Book at least two hours ahead with Logan Coaches on 1800 228 287; the trip back is a separate booking.

groups.name: Roam zone C: parts of Goodna and Bellbird Park
groups.hours: Monday to Friday 6am to 7pm; Saturday 7am to 5:30pm

groups.name: Roam zone D: parts of Barellan Point, Karalee and Chuwar
groups.hours: Weekday peaks only: 6am to 9am and 4pm to 6:30pm

areas.name: Bribie Island on demand
areas.how: Pre-booked shared service. It takes you from anywhere in the roam zone to a key location, from a key location back to anywhere in the zone, or between two key locations. Book ahead, including your trip back.

groups.name: Bribie Island roam zone
groups.hours: Monday to Friday 4:30am to 10pm; Saturday 7am to 10pm; Sunday and public holidays 7am to 7pm

areas.name: Yarrabilba on demand
areas.how: Pre-booked shared service. It takes you from anywhere in the roam zone to a key location, from a key location back into the zone, or between two key locations. It uses set pick-up and drop-off points rather than your front door. Key locations connect with route 587. Flat 50c fare; book ahead, including your trip back.

groups.name: Yarrabilba roam zone
groups.hours: Monday to Friday 5am to 10pm; Saturday 6am to 10pm; Sunday and public holidays 7am to 9pm
